source_of_truth: prd/ARCHITECTURE.md (living truth oracle) and .gsd/milestones/* (GSD state). This roadmap is a derived cold-reader summary; when it disagrees with the oracle or GSD state, those win.

completed_milestone_groups.boundary: Establishes architecture and parser proof foundations, not production legal-answering readiness.

completed_milestone_groups.theme: GraphRAG, FalkorDB, retrieval, ontology, evidence, and semantic scoring proof cycles
completed_milestone_groups.boundary: Provides bounded proof cycles and diagnostics, not final product retrieval quality or ontology/product readiness.

completed_milestone_groups.theme: Consultant XML source structuring, MiniMax-assisted discovery, graph context staging, and workline recovery
completed_milestone_groups.boundary: Establishes bounded Consultant XML/source workflow evidence, not parser completeness for all legal sources.

completed_milestone_groups.theme: ACP / git-lex reusable-core era — construction, registry integration, RDF projection, then externalization
completed_milestone_groups.boundary: CLOSED. The reusable core was externalized to /root/git-lex-kit-acp/ (published github.com/rager306/git-lex-kit-acp v0.2.0) and law-nexus became a profile consumer (M067, D097). Per D098, this era was itself meta-drift (ACP enforcement ran M035-M063 while the product track stalled); D098 now freezes ACP to checkpoint mode (detect+log+flag, non-blocking) until parser data is ready. Do NOT treat ACP/RDF/SHACL/SPARQL/dashboards as source truth or as the next product milestone.

completed_milestone_groups.theme: Structural foundation crystallization + roadmap freshness guard + public README — onion package, ADR standard, compliance gate (pre-commit + CI), library-boundary contract, anti-drift freshness guard, landing page
completed_milestone_groups.boundary: Anti-drift infrastructure only, now fully enforceable locally AND in CI, with a public cold-reader README. M068 (onion package ADR-0001 + compliance gate ADR-0002: pre-commit + .github/workflows CI); M069 (library boundary ADR-0003 + gate-green tree); M070 (roadmap freshness guard); M071 (root README landing + CI badge). Does NOT validate R035/R037/R038, does NOT harden the parser, does NOT introduce FalkorDB/graph/retrieval.

completed_milestone_groups.theme: Consultant parser foundation hardening + test-debt reduction — discovery-based inventory (v2), 12-variant classification, scope-filtered corpus (4 in-scope fixtures, 7860 records), hash-entropy source_id, fixture sha256 chain repair (26 tests fixed across 7 fixtures), 2 builder script patches (2 more tests fixed)
completed_milestone_groups.boundary: Parser foundation: M072 = 6 slices (inventory v2 + 12-variant enum + scope-filtered corpus + hash-entropy source_id). M074/M075 = test-debt reduction (M072-induced failures, not parser content). M073 = deferred (legal-domain foundation). Does NOT validate R035/R037/R038; does NOT introduce FalkorDB/graph/vector/retrieval; does NOT claim parser completeness or legal correctness. 28 test failures remain: 23 Type B inherited (D097, out of scope), 2 Type A: M072-deferred, 3 Type A: blocked-by-corpus-scope-mismatch (semantic).

completed_milestone_groups.theme: Onion architecture migration (M076) + residual script logic migration closure (M077) + cleanup waves (M078) + parser golden case core migration (M079) + source hierarchy wrapper boundary waves (M080)
completed_milestone_groups.boundary: Onion architecture package seams hardened: domain / ports / application / adapters / composition. Adapter seams extracted from script wrappers for source-hierarchy (consultant_hierarchy), parser-golden-cases, parser-records. Build_consultant_hierarchy_records.py retained as thin CLI/report/write/check wrapper preserving test compatibility. Anti-imitation boundary (D098) preserved — ACP/git-lex stays frozen.

completed_milestone_groups.theme: Reactive async architecture assessment (M081) + tracer trace logging guardrails (M082) + tracer event vocabulary and job ledger (M083) + source inventory JSONL job ledger prototype (M084) + repository health and proof artifact freshness triage (M085)
completed_milestone_groups.boundary: Reactive architecture proposed as bounded shell around synchronous deterministic core (not yet implemented as runtime). Job ledger contract defined; append-only JSONL pilot scoped to source-inventory. M085 triaged full-suite signal (53 failures) into evidence-backed clusters with R1-R7 remediation roadmap. Triage work only — does NOT claim full health.

completed_milestone_groups.theme: Debt repair, parser/corpus stabilization, Rust-only transition, ACP/git-lex decommission, the first Rust process tracer and capability evidence mapping
completed_milestone_groups.boundary: M086-M106 repaired debt and stabilized parser/corpus execution. M107 selected the Rust-only product target. M108-M109 archived active ACP/git-lex surfaces, froze parser baselines, created the root Cargo workspace, ln-status tracer and thin Python harness tracer. M110 classified 26 capabilities and 39 Rust candidate records, then replaced implementation-shape parity with observable contract acceptance. Product parity remains unproven.

completed_milestone_groups.theme: Zero-based heterogeneous legal evidence architecture and post-M111 ADR synchronization
completed_milestone_groups.boundary: M111 selected the bounded implementation-neutral semantic baseline: D116/D120 separate authorities, D118 five clocks, D119 C10/C12/C13, D120 complete H1 authority and D123 KOF-DA exact ownership. M112 superseded the pre-M111 crate map, authored ADR-0008 through ADR-0012 and added read-only ADR/decision/owner drift enforcement in pre-commit and CI. No implementation topology was selected.

completed_milestone_groups.theme: HC-01 Observe Source first Rust hostile-case runtime proof
completed_milestone_groups.boundary: Closed Turso/AgentFS storage evidence debt under ADR-0012, implemented a pure hexagonal ln-observe seam, sealed hostile adapter contracts, added a dependency-free process runner, and produced tracked S10-HC-01-RT PASS. Current aggregate is 1 PASS / 0 FAIL / 19 unsupported. No product storage, LadybugDB, ruVector or AgentFS selection was made.

current_milestone.title: HC 01 Observe Source Runtime Proof
current_milestone.goal: Convert HC-01 from unsupported-case into a bounded Rust runtime PASS without selecting product storage or later backends.

recommended_next.title: HC-02 Inventory Immutable Intake runtime proof
recommended_next.why: M113 admitted only the next hostile case after HC-01 PASS. HC-02 is the next P1 intake boundary: re-inventory of the same immutable drop must remain staging/review visibility and must not mint curated/current/authoritative identity or overwrite history.
recommended_next.slices: Close post-M113 roadmap debt, implement pure inventory domain/ports, seal hostile rewrite/curated-exposure contracts, add dependency-free runtime runner, produce S10-HC-02-RT PASS or FAIL, then validate and gate HC-03 only if HC-02 PASS.
recommended_next.non_validation: M113 HC-01 PASS is bounded synthetic interrupted-source proof only. It does not prove source completeness, legal correctness, real network/TLS, product storage readiness, FalkorDB readiness, retrieval quality or E1-E3 capacity. HC-02 through HC-20 remain unsupported until their own runtime proof exists.

frozen.acp_git_lex: decommission and archive only (D104/R066); no active runtime, hook, CI, skill, requirement or source-of-truth role.
frozen.python_product_cutover: blocked until complete Rust whole-system parity; then one controlled archival move.

planning_constraints: Run GitNexus impact before editing code symbols; run GitNexus detect_changes before commits.
Use tracked relative source anchors only (no .gsd/exec, absolute, ignored, or raw-payload anchors).
Keep product/legal/runtime/parser/FalkorDB/retrieval claims bounded unless separate proof exists.
Use explicit lifecycle tags ([proposed]/[bounded]/[smoke]/[validated]/[deferred]) on architectural/state claims; never smooth a bounded/proposed claim up to validated.
Keep Rust as the only target product runtime; Python may remain only as the repository harness defined by ADR-0007.
Do not reintroduce ACP/git-lex outside explicit archive paths.
